content:
ajay (Infra): Quick heads up — next Tue Mar 18 02:00–05:00 PT we'll start migrating our internal SSO from Okta->Keycloak. This includes updating the GitHub org SAML connector and service-account flows. Expect short auth blips for web-console and CI runners. Link with plan: https://confluence.internal/redwood/sso-keycloak-migration :mega:

maria (EngOps): Thanks Ajay. Will this impact CI job tokens or runner auth?

ajay (Infra): CI tokens will be rotated. We're pushing a compatibility proxy for ~48h so most jobs continue, but any jobs that rely on interactive SSO (browser-based) will need re-login. We will post the token rotation schedule on the wiki.

sam (Eng-SRE): For self-hosted runners: do we need to change service principal configs?

ajay (Infra): Yes — runners using the GitHub app via SAML assertions must re-authorize the org app. Steps: 1) create new GitHub SAML app in Keycloak, 2) update org settings, 3) restart runners. I'll paste the ops snippet below.

ajay (Infra): ```bash
# sample: restart runner after updating SSO config
sudo systemctl stop actions-runner.service
# update /etc/runner/sso.conf with new issuer URL
sudo systemctl start actions-runner.service
```

nina (Security): Note: Key rotation + session handling changed — session TTL defaults to 8h. We'll be enforcing MFA on new provider. Any external integrations using SAML metadata must be re-ingested. Security will run an audit during and after cutover.

karen (Product): For Redwood Dedicated customers using SCIM, will provisioning be impacted? We have a customer PV call scheduled Wed.

maria (EngOps): SCIM will keep working if clients point to the new SCIM endpoint. We have a migration shim that translates old attributes, but customers using custom SAML attributes will need re-mapping. Ops will email impacted accounts.

sam (Eng-SRE): Deploy-bot, can you schedule a maintenance window notice in #announcements and update service-status?

deploy-bot: Scheduled maintenance posted for Mar 18 02:00–05:00 PT. Incident channel created: #incidents/sso-keycloak. Subscribers notified. :white_check_mark:

ajay (Infra): Quick config values (do not share externally):
- SAML ACS: `https://sso.redwood-inference.com/auth/realms/redwood/broker/github/endpoint`
- EntityID: `urn:redwood:sso:keycloak`
- Assertion consumer binding: `urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:bindings:HTTP-POST`
(We'll upload metadata XML to Confluence.)

nina (Security): Reminder: rotate the GitHub org SSH deploy key after final cutover. I'll add that to the checklist.

maria (EngOps): Will runbook review tomorrow 09:00 PT in #eng-oncall. Please bring any edge cases (legacy CI, vendor integrations).

sam (Eng-SRE): I'll test a canary org and try to break the proxy tonight. Ping me for creds.

karen (Product): Thanks — please also add a short blurb I can share with beta customers about the minimal impact and SCIM considerations.

ajay (Infra): Will do. TL;DR: short auth blips expected, CI tokens rotated, SCIM mostly compatible; watch the wiki for step-by-step and the incident channel for live updates. :rocket:
